name: Alert
description: A message set inside the page for information, success, a warning or an error.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour and default icon: water, pine, yuzu, camellia, or plain with no icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: Soft fills the alert with the tone's tint. Outline sits on the card colour with a hairline and a light shadow, and only the icon carries the tone.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon, shown at 16 pixels beside the first line. Pass null to show no icon.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Adds a close button in the top end corner. Dismissing folds the alert away over 200ms, then calls this. A button inside the alert with slot="dismiss" dismisses it the same way.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: live
props.description: Gives error and warning alerts role="alert", so screen readers announce them as soon as they appear. Other tones never take a live role.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Accepts every div prop. An alert that mounts after the page has loaded settles in from 4 pixels above.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The first line, in medium weight; accepts every div prop.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Text under the title; links in it are underlined. Accepts every div prop.

props.name: children
props.description: A row of buttons under the text. Buttons from button default to the small size here.
